about:
# TitanAddonMenu

A [Titan Panel](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/titan-panel) plugin that gathers every addon's
"open my settings" entry point into **one** bar button.

Click the **Addons** button for a menu with three sections. Each entry sends a left-click to
the addon's launcher. For addons whose launcher does something different on right-click
(Bartender4: left unlocks bars, right opens options) add an extra "(right click)" row with
`/addonmenu rightclick add Bartender`. The bar button has no tooltip of its own, so it never
covers the menu.

| Section | Source | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| Launchers | LibDataBroker `launcher` objects (the minimap-button convention) | Bartender4, Masque, Plater, BugSack, Prat |
| Addon Compartment | addons that declare `## AddonCompartmentFunc` in their TOC and have no launcher | DialogueUI |
| Slash commands | a user-maintained list for addons that expose neither | Arc Auras (`/arcauras`), Shadowed Unit Frames (`/suf`) |

Once this is on your bar you can hide the individual launcher buttons from Titan
(Titan > Configuration > Plugins) and keep the bar clean.

## Minimap buttons

Since the menu replaces them, minimap buttons made with LibDBIcon (which is nearly all of
them) are **hidden by default**. Nothing is written to the other addons' settings, so
`/addonmenu minimap show` puts every button back exactly as its own addon has it.
`/addonmenu minimap keep <name>` leaves one addon's button visible. Buttons an addon draws
without LibDBIcon are not affected.

## Slash commands

```
/addonmenu                        help
/addonmenu list                   list slash entries
/addonmenu add /cmd Label         add or relabel a slash entry
/addonmenu remove /cmd            remove a slash entry
/addonmenu rightclick add <name>  add a "(right click)" row for launchers matching <name>
/addonmenu rightclick remove <name>
/addonmenu rightclick list        show the patterns and which launchers they match
/addonmenu launchers              list the launcher names seen
/addonmenu minimap hide|show      hide LibDBIcon minimap buttons (default) or stop hiding
/addonmenu minimap keep <name>    keep one addon's minimap button (unkeep to undo)
/addonmenu reset                  restore the defaults
```

Launcher matching is a case-insensitive substring match on the launcher's label or LDB name,
so `bartender` matches `Bartender4`. `Bartender` is in the default right-click list.

`/tam` is an alias for `/addonmenu`.

Slash entries are run by looking the command up in `SlashCmdList` and calling the handler
directly; if it is not registered the text is sent through the chat edit box instead.

## Install

Copy the `TitanAddonMenu` folder into `Interface/AddOns/`. Requires Titan Panel.

Supports WoW: Forever (interface 16001) with Titan Panel 9.3.x. Not tested on retail.

## How it works

It is written as an LDB launcher object rather than a native Titan plugin, which is the
integration path Titan's developer notes recommend (`Titan/_ATitanDoc.lua`, and the bundled
`TitanUI` plugin is the reference example). Titan wraps the object in its own button, handles
placement, the tooltip frame and click dispatch; this addon only supplies the data object,
the tooltip text and a `MenuUtil` context menu.
